name: Coworking Space Operations
audience: independent coworking spaces and small flexible-office operators
topic: member issues and booking exceptions for coworking spaces

products.name: Member Issue Handoff
products.product: A focused coworking member issue handoff tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent coworking spaces and small flexible-office operators
products.problem: Access, noise, internet, billing, mail, and facility issues move between front desk, community, and vendors without one visible owner or member promise.
products.valueProposition: Turns coworking member issue handoff tracking into a visible operating queue so every member issue has a current owner, response promise, resolution evidence, and member acknowledgment.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets coworking member support, coworking issue tracker, flex space operations, and coworking service desk searches.

products.name: Booking Credit Exception Queue
products.product: A focused coworking booking credit exception handling workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent coworking spaces and small flexible-office operators
products.problem: Room credits, cancellations, no-shows, outages, and manual reservations produce billing exceptions that are difficult to explain from the booking ledger alone.
products.valueProposition: Turns coworking booking credit exception handling into a visible operating queue so every disputed or failed booking credit is reconciled to policy, service evidence, and the member balance.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets coworking booking credits, meeting room credit dispute, coworking billing exception, and workspace booking refund searches.
